## Type

## Flow

## Checklist
- [ ] PR title follows convention (e.g. `feat: classification models`)
- [ ] CI and tests pass
- [ ] No files under `data/raw/` modified
- [ ] No secrets, `.env`, credentials or confidential lab data committed
- [ ] Target leakage considered (for data/feature/model changes)
- [ ] Random seeds fixed; new dependencies added to requirements
- [ ] Docs / `docs/team_contributions.md` updated if relevant
